subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the pending approvals CLI ship now as a read-only view of current process-local requests, or wait for the durable canonical approval lifecycle proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/103505?
rationale: Read-only inspection is bounded and already supported by a scoped RPC, but durability, watch behavior, and decision submission define a larger security-sensitive public contract that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Land read-only interim CLI
options.body: Ship table and JSON listing on the existing authorized RPC, document process-local semantics, and defer watch and resolution.

options.title: Wait for durable approvals
options.body: Implement the CLI only after the persisted cross-surface approval lifecycle and record contract are settled.

options.title: Accept full CLI workflow
options.body: Land listing and resolution together only after conflict repair plus live authorization and gateway-roundtrip proof.

recommendation.title: Land read-only interim CLI
recommendation.body: Ship table and JSON listing on the existing authorized RPC, document process-local semantics, and defer watch and resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the current consolidated approval boundary and authored the broader canonical lifecycle proposal.
